desc: The state's machinations and political dealings can prove to be overwhelming for a prospecting leader. To avoid inadequacy in statecraft, it would be wise to focus on an administrative education.
entities.name: Administrative Education

desc: Life brings forth all manner of challenge for those destined to rule. If we are to adequately prepare royal offspring, they must be taught a balanced education.
entities.name: Balanced Education

desc: The lifeblood of our nation is deal-making and a informed diplomatic maneuvers. Thus we must instill the same values to our royal offsprings if we are to maintain our diplomatic edge over our foes.
entities.name: Diplomatic Education

desc: Our wealth is sufficient when it comes to securing in-depth education for our heir. Access to some of the best tutors and material source will grant us unique knowledge as well as the best education money can buy.
entities.name: Expensive Education

desc: Projecting military strength is the backbone of our nation. A focus on military matters and the study of the nature of war as well as management of our armed forces are pivotal for educational purposes.
entities.name: Military Education

desc: By allowing our Patriarch to lead the tutoring process, we can ensure access to the brightest and more devout minds, ensuring both mental and spiritual growth.
entities.name: Patriarch Education
